title: Alice, Bob and Carol Wave Hello
prompt: Three people named Alice, Bob and Carol stand on a stage. Alice is on the left facing Bob, Bob is on the right facing Alice, and Carol stands behind them facing the audience (+Z). Choose their exact starting positions with comfortable space between them. Each waves hello in turn.

beats.prompt: Alice remains standing in place facing Bob, raises one hand, waves hello, then lowers her hand.
Bob remains standing in place facing Alice, raises one hand, waves hello, then lowers his hand.
Carol remains standing behind Alice and Bob facing the audience (+Z), raises one hand, waves hello, then lowers her hand.

warnings: No stage is present in the scene inventory; the requested formation is staged in open space, with desired positions subject to geometry validation.
